known_outcome: Regulator position: the fire safety plan is mandatory and is submitted to the AHJ before construction, alteration or demolition; measures must reflect project size, type, configuration, method and adjacent exposures; fire-department access and firefighting water supply are required; no single solution fits all projects.
review_focus: Separates the mandatory fire safety plan from the performance measures
Asks which adjacent exposures and distances the plan documents
Flags fire-department access and water-supply evidence
Does not state the measures are sufficient
alberta_evaluation_use: source extraction and administrative evidence exercise; not technical approval
instruction: Do not upload this file with the test prompt. Published outcome is not a new technical approval or a complete scored ground truth.
